What's new in Vekrun 0.5.3 — One Board

• One Board: the Board and the Ticket board are one page with Overview and Tickets tabs. New work item opens right on the Board and the new item appears in the queue — no more jumping to the AI Factory. The ticket board's setup (connections, settings, activity, plans, Markdown) is one Manage menu, and each opens as a dialog.
• Production monitoring: "Errors since" beside Sync now. Pick a day and Vekrun brings in each application's errors seen since then (they arrive quietly, without new-incident alerts); clear it for all history.
• Datadog through the browser sign-in syncs Error Tracking again (Datadog started requiring a "telemetry" argument), and APM isn't offered there any more instead of failing every sync (Datadog's browser sign-in has no tool for it; API keys still bring it). Vekrun now fills any such "why are you calling" argument a vendor adds, without ever inventing data.
